metrics.definition: The persisted scenario mission task_kinds equal the declarative expected order.
The persisted terminal scenario phase belongs to the stage allow-list.
At least one child quality report is rejected or one child terminates failed.
A child records degraded source coverage, a provisional delivery, or an explicit source/quality gap.
A final child output records the provisional artifact it supersedes.
Every persisted experiment file and every declared original external input file has SHA-256 evidence.
